title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Temporary Accounts Administrator

Location: Southampton
Job Type: Full-Time Temporary Contract
Start Date: Immediate Start Available

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Accounts Administrator to join a busy finance team based in Southampton. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who enjoys working with financial data, has strong attention to detail, and is available to start immediately.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of financial data accurately and efficiently
- Maintaining both Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger records
- Matching, batching and coding invoices
- Processing supplier invoices and customer payments
- Performing account reconciliations and investigating discrepancies
- Updating and maintaining accurate financial records within the accounting system
- Supporting the wider finance team with administrative and accounting duties
- Ensuring all transactions are processed in line with company procedures
- Assisting with month-end finance tasks where required

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience within an accounts administration, accounts assistant, or finance administration role
- Strong working knowledge of Sage Accounting software
- Experience with Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger functions
- Proven experience of matching, batching and coding invoices
- Reconciliation experience
- Excellent data entry skills with a high level of accuracy
- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies
- Good organisational and time management skills
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications

Personal Attributes
- Methodical and organised approach to work
- Reliable and dependable
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Positive attitude with a willingness to support the wider finance function

What's on Offer
- Immediate start
- Full-time temporary assignment
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunity to gain valuable experience within a busy finance team

If you are an experienced Accounts Administrator with Sage experience and are available to start immediately, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for immediate consideration.

title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Southampton

A great opportunity has become available for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join a well-established law firm at its Park Gate office in Southampton. Working as part of a busy and friendly Commercial Property team, you will provide essential day-to-day legal and administrative support to Fee Earners across a varied commercial property caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Fee Earners with a varied commercial property caseload.
- Liaising with clients and third parties, including estate agents, landlords and other solicitors.
- Opening new files and matters on the firm's Case Management system.
- Drafting correspondence, documents and precedents on behalf of Fee Earners.
- Completing ID checks for clients.
- Providing general administrative and legal support to the Property team as required.

You will ideally have:
- At least 2 years plus legal secretarial or legal assistant experience within Property.
- Experience supporting commercial property matters.
- Strong legal administration and secretarial skills.
- Experience with audio typing and digital dictation systems.
- Previous experience using a Case Management system.

What they Offer:
- Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm and in the office.
- Salary depending on experience - £26,000 - £28,000
- 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays. Increasing by 1 day per year after 5 years' service (not exceeding 30 days)
- Pension scheme.
- Discounted legal services after one year service.
- Discounted gym membership relating to the Health Cash Plan.

title: Inside Account Manager
description:

If you are are strong Inside Account Manager or a Graduate looking for first opportunity in a Global organisation please do not hesitate to contact The Work Shop today to discuss this fabulous vacancy

title: Patent Paralegal
description:
Patent Paralegal/Secretary - Southampton

Our client is a well-established firm with a strong reputation for providing specialist services to a varied client base. The firm offers a supportive and professional working environment, where accuracy, teamwork and high standards of client service are valued.

The firm is looking to recruit a Patent Paralegal/Secretary to support its Chemistry team in Southampton. This position will involve a varied mix of administrative and Paralegal responsibilities, working closely with Patent Attorneys to keep cases running smoothly, manage important deadlines and provide an efficient service to clients.

Responsibilities
- Review incoming correspondence, post and faxes, identifying urgent matters and work requiring Paralegal input
- Provide secretarial and Paralegal assistance, including audio and copy typing, preparing standard letters and processing client invoices
- Handle routine Paralegal tasks independently, ensuring work is completed accurately and in a timely manner
- Maintain case reminders and monitor key dates to ensure Patent Attorneys remain aware of upcoming deadlines
- Manage diaries and appointments, coordinating schedules and keeping track of Patent Attorneys' availability
- Monitor emails and take messages during periods of absence, ensuring urgent matters are redirected to another Patent Attorney where necessary
- Distribute work to Paralegal Assistants and offer support, guidance and informal training as appropriate
- Take responsibility for the organisation and maintenance of case files
- Prioritise urgent tasks and ensure critical legal deadlines are met

Requirements
- A minimum of two years' experience in a patent secretarial or Paralegal position, ideally within a fast-paced environment
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling complex or deadline-driven tasks
- A structured and methodical approach to work, with the ability to apply logical thinking to individual assignments
- Excellent time management skills and the ability to balance changing priorities and competing deadlines
- The ability to adapt to the individual working styles and requirements of multiple Patent Attorneys, colleagues and clients
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships
- A self-sufficient approach, with the confidence to manage routine responsibilities independently
- A willingness to learn, develop and contribute to the wider team

title: Purchase Ledger Administrator
description:
Amour Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Purchase Ledger Administrator on behalf of our long-standing client based in Southampton.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable professional looking for a varied role within a busy finance team.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager, you'll take ownership of key purchase ledger responsibilities while also supporting the wider account's function.

What you'll be doing
- Managing the day-to-day purchase ledger
- Processing purchase invoices accurately and efficiently
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies
- Preparing and processing monthly supplier payment runs
- Posting purchase payments and issuing remittance advices to suppliers
- Posting daily bank transactions, including receipts and payments
- Assisting with bank reconciliations
- Supporting with credit control and general accounts administration

What we're looking for
- Previous experience within Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable or a similar accounts administration role is essential
- Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and accounting systems
- Good numerical and organisational skills
- Ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines

Salary: company happy to negotiate for experience

Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm

If you're an experienced Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable professional who enjoys a varied role and would like to join a well-established business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Administrator

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic, committed and well-motivated Team Administrator to join the Urgent Community Response team in Southampton. The Administrator role is a pivotal part of the Service, supporting both the administrative, clinical and therapy teams across Southampton City. You will need to possess strong prioritising and excellent organisational skills together with the ability to remain calm in a busy and dynamic environment. The work is varied, challenging and fast paced which requires a flexible approach. We are looking for someone that has experience in working in a team. You need to be able to demonstrate strong communication skills, be organised and possess good IT skills, including competence with Microsoft Office. Experience of System One is desirable although all training will be provided. The successful applicant must be flexible, should possess excellent time management skills, be self-motivated and have a positive attitude with a customer focused approach. This is a full time post (37.5 hours pw) based in Oakley Road, Southampton. There will be an expectation to work some weekends but hours can be discussed at interview. Only open to applicants from Hampshire & Isle of Wight NHS system, which is limited to: Hampshire and Isle of Wight ICB, Hampshire & Isle of Wight Healthcare FT, Portsmouth Hospitals University NHS Trust, University Hospital Southampton FT, South Central Ambulance Service, Isle of Wight NHS FT or Hampshire Hospitals FT.
